pandas.TimedeltaIndex.round

pandas 3.1.1 · Index objects · method

Round values to a specified precision. For datetime-like objects use a frequency.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

TimedeltaIndex.round(freq, ambiguous='raise', nonexistent='raise')

Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
freq
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      str or Offset
Specify the frequency or offset, such as "D" for a day or "MS" for a calendar month start.


ambiguous
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'raise'		
      'infer', bool-ndarray, 'NaT'
Resolve local times that occur twice when clocks move backward.


nonexistent
      Optional
Positional or keyword
Default 'raise'		
      'shift_forward', 'shift_backward', 'NaT', timedelta
Resolve local times skipped when clocks move forward.

    
Returns
TimedeltaIndex
